name: autodex_precision_insertion
camera_serial_policy: resolve every serial from the active ParaDex pc.json at runtime

calibration.selection: pass an explicit --calib_dir whose intrinsics and extrinsics cover every active camera serial
calibration.do_not_use: a ZeroDex camera snapshot or a calibration missing any active AutoDex camera

hand_eye.selection: newest valid session proven to be Franka by metadata/eef link or 7-DOF qpos

notes: The socket and key use the same AutoDex camera set and world frame.
ZeroDex camera ownership, capture4/capturenew, and free-run capture are outside this experiment.
ZeroDex remains a read-only design reference for the future VLM outcome checker only.
